title: CI setup-pyenv: bump the pyenv tag and its expected commit SHA together
answers: How do I upgrade pyenv in CI so model-serving tests can build a new Python version?
Why does the setup-pyenv step fail with a pyenv SHA mismatch?
Where is the pyenv version and its verification hash pinned for Linux runners?
Which pyenv release includes build definitions for a given Python patch version?
body:
Path: .github/actions/setup-pyenv/action.yml (Linux step) clones pyenv by tag with retries into $HOME/.pyenv, then compares `git rev-parse HEAD` against a hard-coded expected_sha and exits on mismatch; model-serving tests use it to recreate environments.
Rule: a pyenv upgrade must change both the `--branch` tag in the clone command and `expected_sha` to the commit verified for that tag, in the same edit. Confirm the new tag includes build definitions for every Python patch version the CI pins need (e.g. 3.10.21 and 3.11.16 for the v2.8.5 bump) before relying on it.
Symptom: if only the tag is bumped, the clone fails the SHA check and the job errors with 'pyenv SHA mismatch'; if only the SHA is changed, the step fails the same way.
Constraints: applies to the Linux branch of setup-pyenv only; it does not select Python versions itself (that is setup-python's job) and does not affect macOS or Windows runners.
applies: CI composite action that installs pyenv on Linux runners for model-serving environment recreation.
says: Model deployment tests fail during setup with a verification checksum mismatch error.
Enable model serving tests to run against newly released runtime versions on Linux.
Model environment recreation fails while installing the version management utility.
The Linux test pipeline failed because the version manager verification hash was rejected.
Support newer runtime releases in model serving tests by updating the version manager.
search: In .github/actions/setup-pyenv/action.yml, upgrading pyenv on Linux runners requires bumping the clone --branch tag and the pinned expected_sha together in the same change. The step clones pyenv into $HOME/.pyenv and verifies git rev-parse HEAD against expected_sha, failing with a SHA mismatch if either value is updated in isolation. Upgrades must verify that the target tag contains build definitions for required Python patch versions, such as 3.10.21 and 3.11.16 for v2.8.5. Applies only to Linux runners recreating environments for model-serving tests; it does not select Python versions or affect macOS and Windows runners.
